cards.example_en: The whole team contributed to the formulation of our plan.
cards.example_zh: 整个团队都参与了我们计划的制定。
cards.explain_zh: 常用the formulation of，表示计划等的制定。

cards.example_en: Effective policy formulation requires reliable evidence and meaningful consultation with the communities most likely to be affected.
cards.example_zh: 有效的政策制定需要可靠的证据，并与最可能受到影响的社区进行有意义的协商。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Parents left messages on the school forum about lunch.
cards.example_zh: 家长们在学校论坛上留言谈论午餐。

cards.example_en: We found a tiny shell fossil inside the rock.
cards.example_zh: 我们在岩石里发现了一枚小小的贝壳化石。
cards.explain_zh: fossil fuels指煤、石油、天然气等化石燃料。

cards.example_en: The company is looking for alternatives to fossil fuels.
cards.example_zh: 这家公司正在寻找化石燃料的替代品。

cards.example_en: This jacket costs a fraction of the original price.
cards.example_zh: 这件夹克的售价只是原价的一小部分。
cards.explain_zh: a fraction of常强调占比极小，不只是一般部分。

cards.example_en: This jacket costs a fraction of the original price.
cards.example_zh: 这件夹克的售价只是原价的一小部分。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A fracture of the tibia may require several months of rehabilitation before an athlete can safely resume training.
cards.example_zh: 胫骨骨折可能需要数月康复，运动员才能安全恢复训练。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: The chickens wander freely around the garden all day.
cards.example_zh: 这些鸡整天在花园里自由走动。
cards.explain_zh: freely主要指不受限制；免费用for free。

cards.example_en: Rubbing your hands together creates friction and warms them.
cards.example_zh: 双手搓动会产生摩擦，让手暖和起来。
cards.explain_zh: 物理摩擦与人际不和两义均通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Their cottage stands on the fringe of the forest.
cards.example_zh: 他们的小屋位于森林边缘。
cards.explain_zh: “刘海”英式用fringe，美式通常用bangs。

cards.example_en: Affordable housing on the urban fringe often leaves residents dependent on cars for their daily journeys.
cards.example_zh: 城市外围的经济适用住房往往使居民的日常出行依赖汽车。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The two proposals differ fundamentally in their approach to funding.
cards.example_zh: 这两项提议在筹资方式上有根本区别。

cards.example_en: A strange orange fungus was growing on the fallen tree.
cards.example_zh: 倒下的树上长着一种奇怪的橙色真菌。
cards.explain_zh: 复数常用fungi；真菌不属于植物。

cards.example_en: Her cooking is a fusion of different regional styles.
cards.example_zh: 她的烹饪融合了不同地区的风格。
cards.explain_zh: 核聚变用fusion；核裂变用fission，注意区分。

cards.example_en: Scientists are investigating nuclear fusion as a potential source of abundant energy with low carbon emissions.
cards.example_zh: 科学家正在研究核聚变，将其视为一种潜在的、供应充足且碳排放低的能源。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I dipped a toe in to gauge the water temperature.
cards.example_zh: 我把一只脚趾伸进水里，试了试水温。
cards.explain_zh: 读音同gage；既可用仪器测量，也可凭信息判断。

cards.example_en: Calling all teenagers lazy is an unfair generalization.
cards.example_zh: 说所有青少年都懒惰，是一种不公平的笼统论断。
cards.explain_zh: 英式也写 generalisation；概括未必可靠。

cards.example_en: We cannot generalize from the experience of a single household.
cards.example_zh: 我们不能仅凭一个家庭的经历作概括。

cards.example_en: The two populations are genetically similar.
cards.example_zh: 这两个种群在遗传上相似。

cards.example_en: Advances in genetics have changed our understanding of inheritance.
cards.example_zh: 遗传学的进展改变了我们对遗传的理解。

cards.example_en: My little cousin dressed as a ghost for the party.
cards.example_zh: 我的小表弟打扮成幽灵去参加派对。
cards.explain_zh: a ghost of a smile指一丝若有若无的笑。

cards.example_en: The essay discusses the effects of globalization on local businesses.
cards.example_zh: 这篇文章讨论全球化对本地企业的影响。

cards.example_en: A curious goat poked its head through the fence.
cards.example_zh: 一只好奇的山羊把头探出了围栏。
cards.explain_zh: goat是山羊，sheep是绵羊；替罪羊用scapegoat。

cards.example_en: Her goodness showed when she shared her last sandwich.
cards.example_zh: 她把最后一个三明治分给别人，显露出善良的本性。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词通常不可数；My goodness表示惊讶。

cards.example_en: Steaming vegetables can preserve more of their natural goodness than boiling them for long periods.
cards.example_zh: 与长时间水煮相比，蒸蔬菜能保留更多天然营养。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The shop sells handmade goods from nearby villages.
cards.example_zh: 这家店出售附近村庄制作的手工商品。
cards.explain_zh: goods是复数名词；一件商品可说an item。

cards.example_en: The road has a steep gradient near the village.
cards.example_zh: 这条公路在村庄附近坡度很陡。

cards.example_en: Add one gram of salt and stir the soup.
cards.example_zh: 加入一克盐，然后搅拌汤。
cards.explain_zh: 符号为g；复数为grams；一千克等于一千克中的一千克？

cards.example_en: Comparing the nutrients provided per gram can help consumers make more informed choices about packaged foods.
cards.example_zh: 比较每克食物所含的营养成分，有助于消费者更明智地选择包装食品。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our teacher explained the grammatical rules using simple examples.
cards.example_zh: 老师用简单的例子解释了这些语法规则。
cards.explain_zh: 可指“语法方面的”，也可指句子“符合语法的”。

cards.example_en: Although grammatical accuracy matters in language learning, students also need opportunities to develop confidence through conversation.
cards.example_zh: 尽管语法准确性对语言学习很重要，学生也需要通过对话建立自信的机会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Draw a graph to show how the temperature changed this week.
cards.example_zh: 画一张图表，显示这周气温是怎样变化的。

cards.example_en: Students grasp complex scientific concepts more easily when teachers connect them to familiar everyday experiences.
cards.example_zh: 教师将复杂的科学概念与熟悉的日常经历联系起来时，学生更容易理解。
cards.explain_zh: 表示理解时可作动词；名词常用a grasp of。

cards.example_en: Gravity pulls the ball to the ground.
cards.example_zh: 重力把球拉向地面。

cards.example_en: Copy the numbers into the grid before you start the puzzle.
cards.example_zh: 开始做谜题之前，先把数字抄进网格里。

cards.example_en: My gross pay looks much better than my take-home pay.
cards.example_zh: 我的税前工资看起来比实发工资高多了。
cards.explain_zh: 财务中gross为扣除前总额，net为净额。

cards.example_en: Gross domestic product measures economic output, but it does not fully reflect citizens' quality of life.
cards.example_zh: 国内生产总值衡量经济产出，却不能全面反映公民的生活质量。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The study investigates bacteria living in the human gut.
cards.example_zh: 这项研究调查生活在人类肠道中的细菌。

cards.example_en: This pond provides a perfect habitat for frogs.
cards.example_zh: 这个池塘为青蛙提供了理想的栖息地。
cards.explain_zh: habit 是习惯，habitat 是动植物的栖息地。

cards.example_en: The lift stopped halfway up the narrow shaft.
cards.example_zh: 电梯在狭窄井道的中途停了下来。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: Our teacher gave us a handout about healthy eating.
cards.example_zh: 老师给我们发了一份关于健康饮食的讲义。
cards.explain_zh: handout是名词；hand out是动词短语，意为分发。

cards.example_en: We celebrated the apple harvest with a homemade pie.
cards.example_zh: 我们做了一个自制苹果派，庆祝苹果丰收。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词可指收割活动，也可指收获的作物或产量。

cards.example_en: A hawk circled slowly above the open field.
cards.example_zh: 一只鹰在空旷的田野上方缓缓盘旋。
cards.explain_zh: 鹰派hawk与主张和平的鸽派dove相对。

cards.example_en: The owners plan to headquarter the company in Singapore.
cards.example_zh: 公司所有者计划把总部设在新加坡。

cards.example_en: A thick hedge separates our garden from the pavement.
cards.example_zh: 一道茂密的树篱将我们的花园与人行道隔开。
cards.explain_zh: 金融义常用 a hedge against，表示防范某种风险。

cards.example_en: Some investors purchase gold as a hedge against inflation, although its value can also fluctuate.
cards.example_zh: 一些投资者购买黄金以防范通货膨胀，尽管黄金的价值也可能波动。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The model shows a helix winding around a central axis.
cards.example_zh: 这个模型显示了围绕中心轴盘旋的螺旋形。

cards.example_en: The nurse explained how vaccination can prevent some hepatitis infections.
cards.example_zh: 护士解释了接种疫苗如何预防某些类型的肝炎感染。
cards.explain_zh: 通常为不可数名词；并非所有肝炎都由病毒引起。

cards.example_en: The farmer reduced the amount of herbicide used on the field.
cards.example_zh: 农民减少了田间除草剂的用量。

word.example_en: Fossil evidence helps scientists understand how animals adapted to environmental changes over millions of years.
word.example_zh: 化石证据帮助科学家了解动物在数百万年间如何适应环境变化。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Only a small fraction of household waste is recycled in some rapidly growing cities.
word.example_zh: 在一些快速发展的城市，只有少量生活垃圾得到回收利用。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
